name: Papua New Guinea
description: Papua New Guinea from the first farmers of Kuk to its hundreds of peoples, German and Australian rule, the Kokoda Track and independence in 1975.

checkpoints.name: The first farmers
checkpoints.note: People reached New Guinea at least 50,000 years ago and farmed the highlands at Kuk 9,000 years ago.

checkpoints.name: Colonial rule
checkpoints.note: Germany took the north and Britain the south in 1884; Australia ran both. The Kokoda Track was fought in 1942.

checkpoints.name: Independent PNG
checkpoints.note: Papua New Guinea became independent in 1975. Bougainville's war lasted a decade.
